summary: Frontend regression validation of /pagamentos page after visual/structural redesign (Pagamentos.js + PagamentoDetalheModal.jsx). All requested flows verified end-to-end via Playwright against the public preview URL with user adilsonsoares203@gmail.com. Login (senha + turnstile test key), KPIs, empréstimo collapse/expand, pagar-inline → modal open, partial payment submit (R$ 10,00 PIX) with confirmation card, ESC + X close, mass-selection floating bar (btn-cobrar-em-massa visible), Histórico tab with método filter + CSV export download — all PASS. No regressions vs previous behavior; all data-testids preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: Pagamentos.js is ~1200 lines — consider extracting ParcelaRow, KpiCard, EmptyState, ConfirmacoesList, HistoricoTable/Card, PendentesFiltros into separate files (matches project's >700 lines guideline).
handleExportarHistorico builds CSV client-side ignoring the /api/exportacao endpoint — acceptable for this simple case but could be unified.
Turnstile test-key path relies on ~2.5s wait; consider surfacing a ready state to reduce flakiness in tests.
PagamentoDetalheModal: onMouseDown backdrop-close is a nice touch; ESC + X + backdrop all close correctly. No a11y role='dialog'/aria-modal on the container — consider adding for screen readers.
test_credentials: adilsonsoares203@gmail.com / Teste@123 (Turnstile test key auto-passes; wait ~3s before Entrar)
seed_data_creation: One partial payment of R$ 10,00 (PIX) was registered on parcela 37e7bc80... of user adilsonsoares203. Data is test-restored from backup per user note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Redesign of /pagamentos is functionally intact. All critical data-testids exist and behave as documented: pagamentos-title, total-recebido-card, total-pendente-card, atrasadas-card, taxa-recebimento-card, tab-pendentes, tab-historico, emprestimo-header-<id>, btn-pagar-inline-<id>, btn-cobrar-inline-<id>, checkbox-parcela-<id>, btn-selecionar-todas, btn-cobrar-em-massa, pagamento-modal, cancelar-button, input-valor-pago, input-data-pagamento, textarea-observacoes, metodo-<pix|transferencia|dinheiro|cartao|boleto>, confirmar-pagamento-button, confirmacoes-pagamento, filtro-metodo, filtro-cliente-historico, filtro-data, btn-exportar-csv.
